profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at The Home Depot
profile.summary:
Distinguished Principal Cloud & AI Systems Architect with over 25 years of experience designing and leading the architecture of large-scale, mission-critical cloud platforms for Fortune 500 and high-growth technology companies.
Strategic technical leader who partners closely with CEOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and product leadership to define and execute multi-year technology strategies that balance innovation, operational excellence, and sustainable velocity. Proven ability to influence architecture direction across large engineering organizations (500–2500+ engineers), establish lightweight governance, and align distributed teams around coherent, evolvable platform visions.

Core focus areas include:
• Designing resilient, cloud-native architectures on GCP using domain-driven design, event-driven patterns (Kafka, Pub/Sub), and controlled microservices boundaries that remain maintainable at scale

• Establishing enterprise resilience standards through circuit breakers, bulkheads, graceful degradation, multi-region active-active patterns, and disciplined chaos engineering practices

• Integrating AI and machine learning strategically — from predictive operations and intelligent auto-scaling to embedding ML models into core business workflows

• Leading cloud platform transformations that modernize legacy estates into observable, secure, and cost-efficient ecosystems using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, paved-path CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code

• Driving adoption of serverless, data mesh, and MLOps practices that significantly improve developer productivity while reducing operational risk and total cost of ownership

• Shaping multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud strategies, FinOps discipline, security/compliance frameworks, and long-term technology roadmaps

Recognized for clear communication of complex trade-offs to executive stakeholders, building consensus across organizational boundaries, and delivering architectures that remain flexible and performant for 5–10 years while supporting rapid business evolution.

✰ ✰ ✰ ✰ ✰ ✰ ✰ 
Core Strengths
Strategic Technology Leadership ✰ Cloud-Native Architecture ✰ Distributed Systems Design ✰ AI & MLOps Strategy ✰ Resilience & Observability Engineering ✰ Platform Modernization ✰ Multi-Cloud Strategy & FinOps ✰ Event-Driven Architecture ✰ Domain-Driven Design ✰ Executive-Level Influence & Communication ✰ Long-Term Technical Roadmapping

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Led and mentored teams from four to nine Software Engineers on software architecture/design, design patterns, design principles, Java idioms and agile methods.   Worked with stakeholders across the organization to understand their asks in our software system,  turned the stakeholders’ asks into stories, led and managed my team to successful delivery of the stakeholder’s asks as well as implemented the frameworks and infrastructure code that were necessitated by the various stakeholder asks.   Worked with the Product Owner building roadmaps,  both short-term and long term, that allowed the team to enjoy many successes including creating new high-value REST Java services as well as identifying and retiring legacy services that were outdated and had a high total cost of ownership.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Key contributor to the early and continued success of SocialCare that has secured multiple rounds of funding by personally applying sound software development and design architecture principles, agile methods,  expert level problem solving and Java development skills coupled with lessons learned from hard earned experience.  Worked with Product Owner using Scrum to define, prioritize, and deliver on a predictable basis high-value features for the platform product and various other applications that utilizes the platform.   Our platform is centered around HL7’s FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) set of standards for the healthcare market.

PROJECTS & ACCOMPLISHMENTS
* Designed, implemented and coded (Java) our platform’s FHIR RESTful API focusing on search capabilities across all relevant FHIR resources using Spring REST controllers, spring-data and MongoDB.
* Replaced existing ANT build scripts with a fully automated Maven ecosystem that includes: Nexus, maven-release-plugin, several other existing and custom Maven plugins, with Jenkins for CI/CD which I  am responsible.
* Led the design and development effort for the scheduler and survey applications that utilize our platform’s RESTful APIs
* Responsible for introducing and implementing the first phase of Microservices to our platform utilizing spring-boot and spring-actuator
* Designed, implemented and coded phase II of the MongoDB FHIR data migrator utilizing spring-boot, spring-data and Mongobee.
* Key member of  the production support team
* Upgraded our platform through the different versions of FHIR listed above, sole contributor for the FHIR v3.0.1 upgrade

positions.title: Senior Java Developer (Consultant - 90 Day Contract)
positions.description:
Worked to help the company pay down their technical debt and clear out backlog of defects to meet stringent deadlines on a short-term basis (90 day contract):

Projects & Accomplishments: 
•	Designed, architected, coded, created automated tests (JUnit), and implemented full web stack solutions that fixed many defects as well as paid down some of the technical debt that has accumulated over time; through proper use of SOLID object oriented design principles and usage of the technologies listed below.  Technology stack includes:
	•	mySQL, JPA 1.3.1 (Hibernate 4.1.9), Java 7, Groovy 2.3.4, JUnit 4.10, RESTful Web Services via Jersey 2.2, Sencha Architect 3.x, Sencha CMD 5.0.231 (Sencha product suite for front end development;JavaScript, HTML5, CSS, etc..)
•	Improved the Maven build system by modifying and educating many of the second level and lower pom's parent's <relativePath/> usage.  This allowed for faster build times and future proofed the Maven build hierarchy when the previous technique will be deprecated.
•	Completed contract which put the company in a strong position to meet their deliverables and deadlines.

positions.title: Senior Java Engineer
positions.description:
Gathered & define business requirements while managing the risks to improve business processes and translating the requirements into systems solution by preparing functional specifications. Coordinated with end users to define engagement along with project development and resource estimates. Managed guidance on the projects and its requirements to the clients over the technology, processes and applications while updating them on the regular project related developments.  Analyzed technical issues/problems and suggested remediation options. Reviewed detailed designs and participated in code reviews. Provided input (scope, level of difficulty, etc.) regarding estimates for features and enhancements. Identified ways to improve design and development processes.

Projects & Accomplishments: 
•	Designed and implemented a custom login mechanism (JSE 6) for our web and desktop client utilizing a shared database realm across two different user stores.
•	Converted ANT build system containing ~40 build.xml files to Maven 3.x containing ~10 pom.xml files
•	Implemented and Coached Scrum/Kanban to the R&D department (25+ developers, 6 managers).
•	Implemented mobile (iPad/iPhone) solution, sliced functionality from WorkForce Management Product using RESTful webservices and JSON.
•	Coached developers on proper Test Driven Development and mocking strategies.

positions.title: Lead Java Developer/ Agile Coach
positions.description:
Managed the complete life cycle of development/ support projects including analysis of the client requirements; translating new ideas into clients solutions; requirements development; delivery, support, analysis and documentation. Successfully developed various projects within the strict time frame. 

Projects & Accomplishments
•	Implemented the Claims Replication, EDIFECS Codeset Update Tool and Care Profile Enhancements projects using Java 6, Spring and Hibernate.
•	Created custom reports using Groovy.
•	Selected to be a member of a team that formed Availity’s new Software Development Process, implemented Scrum and Kanban.
•	Coached developers on proper Test Driven Development and mocking strategies using Groovy.

positions.title: Lead Java Developer/ Agile Coach
positions.description:
Coached and implemented Agile Methodology, best practices, processes, and tools across multiple agile product teams and across the organization. Provided instruction and training to software development teams in the area of agile software principles

Projects & Accomplishments: 
•	Implemented a Web Services layer <SOAP> & <REST/JSON>, using Asix 2, into their existing product, Genius Room.
•	Coached the team to a successful adoption of Agile Methodoloiges (Scrum, XP, Lean, Crystal)
•	Implemented a Test Driven Development strategy into an existing code base with the help of Cobertura.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description:
Coordinated with clients for requirement gathering and finalization of technical specifications. Adhered to plans & schedules, participated in team meetings for individual projects. Handled various technical aspects like project documentation, system design & integration, monitoring critical paths & took appropriate actions. Designed and developed several Spring Web Services

Projects & Accomplishments: 
•	Coached team on how to implement and utilize Scrum (Agile Methodology) effectively. 
•	Mentored client's staff on how to convert their Enterprise build from ANT to Maven 2.

positions.title: Agile Technologist
positions.description:
Manage complex software development, architecture, and integration projects in a fast paced, constantly changing Agile environment. Responsible for effectively initiating, planning, scheduling, estimating, forecasting, coordinating, controlling, managing and delivering all activities for projects and related release initiatives. Oversaw the day-to-day progress of project(s) and release initiatives with regard to time, budget, scope and quality. Provide leadership, direction and integrated activities with other IT departments to ensure successful implementation and support.

Projects & Accomplishments: 
•	Participated in several two-week iterations developing features for a Natural Language Processing application that searches structured data (SQL Databases) written in Java.
•	Utilized Test Driven Development with Junit and Feature Driven Development with GreenPepper to implement software features.

✰ ✰ ✰ ✰ ✰ ✰ ✰ ✰

CORE COMPETENCIES: Software Design, Software Development, Software Architecture, Application Performance Tuning, Service Oriented Architecture, Project Implementation, Application Support, Database Management, Agile Framework, Troubleshooting, Cross-functional Coordination, Team Management, Client Relations Management, End User Training, Strong Interpersonal Skills, Agile Methodologies, Java Enterprise Edition, SaaS, Test Driven Development, Web Services, Software Development, Tomcat, JSP, Unix, REST, Servlets, Web Applications, JavaScript, SOA, Integration, Design Patterns, Enterprise Software, SQL, Software Engineering, Struts, Continuous Integration, Subversion, Architecture, Databases, IT Strategic Management, Enterprise Architecture, Architecture Governance, Application Development, Solution Architecture, Software Delivery Management, Customer Satisfaction, Consulting, Strategy, Business Process Management, , IT Strategy

testScores.name: DISC Personality Report
testScores.description: "You are individualistic, demanding and persistent. You seek out challenging situations and are responsive to competition. You should be able to handle the daily stresses and pressures of work and life. However, when really pushed, you may become rather irritable and fault-finding. People see you as a 'take charge' sort of person who is self-confident and strives for results."
